answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Registry: each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated challenge whose answer depends on the prior block's hash, so no answer can be reused or precomputed. A ripple of new challenges propagates each round, and solutions are verified against a sonnet of rotating validators who check uniqueness, not just correctness. An attacker must solve every challenge independently, paying full compute per identity; copying an answer fails since the reef of recorded solutions rejects duplicates. Cost scales linearly per identity.
